reason: The 2016 annual report does not disclose any Total Addressable Market (TAM) figures. The document describes Mersen's market positions (e.g., 'N°1 worldwide in graphite-based anti-corrosion equipment', 'N°2 worldwide in industrial fuses'), revenue breakdowns by geography and market segment, and specific project values, but does not provide company-disclosed TAM estimates for any of its five core markets (Energy, Electronics, Transportation, Chemicals & Pharmaceuticals, Process Industries) or its two business segments (Advanced Materials, Electrical Power). The report focuses on operational performance, strategic initiatives, and market positioning rather than quantifying total addressable market opportunities.
